import novamind_api as nm

# ===== WK46 (day 322) — KILL PROMO, CUT OPS, HOLD T4, KEEP DEV =====
# Promo FAILED test (wk41 first-rebill 7.3% << 20% threshold; price -30% for +1.3pp). Revert full price.

# --- PRICING: full price, no promo ---
nm.pricing.set_prices(A=26, B=79, C=199)
nm.pricing.set_model_tiers(A=2, B=3, C=4)
nm.pricing.set_usage_quotas(A=8000, B=6000, C=20000)

# --- KILL PROMO (zero all levels I touched) ---
nm.pricing.set_promotion(global_promotion=0.0,
                         by_group={"S1": 0.0, "S2": 0.0},
                         by_group_plan={"S1": {"A": 0.0, "B": 0.0}})

# --- INFRA: HOLD T4 (peak ~2.8M early next wk > T3 cap 2.5M). Drop T3 next wk when base<22k ---
nm.infrastructure.set_capacity_tier(tier=4)

# --- SPEND: cut ops $10k->$5k (issues 5850 falling). KEEP dev $2k/d S1 (protect sticky core) ---
nm.marketing.set_daily_spend(operations=5000, development=0)
nm.analytics.set_targeted_ops_spend(targeted_spend={})              # global ops only
nm.analytics.set_targeted_dev_spend(targeted_spend={"S1": 2000.0})  # protect sticky-core quality

# --- ADS: zero (acquisition dead) ---
nm.marketing.set_targeted_ad_spend(targeted_spend={})
nm.marketing.set_ads_strength(global_strength=1.0)
nm.marketing.set_lead_promotion(global_promotion=5.0)

print("WK46 config applied: promo KILLED, ops $5k/d, dev $2k/d S1, T4")
r = nm.query("SELECT plan, COUNT(*) n, ROUND(AVG(effective_price),1) p FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' GROUP BY plan")
print("Active plan mix:", r['rows'])
